researchQuestion: Do LW0 stable invariants and anti-laws generalize across 250 years of materially different scientific, engineering, industrial and institutional worlds, and what historical residual structures remain unexplained by the 2026 agent-research model?

epochs.label: Electricity, steel, industrial chemistry, public-health systems
Mass production, aviation, radio, quantum/nuclear science, antibiotics
Transistor, computation, molecular biology, nuclear/space systems
Genomics, cloud/mobile, renewable scaling, data-intensive science, deep-learning resurgence
Foundation models/agents, CRISPR translation, mRNA platforms, modern batteries/energy systems

domainCoverageRule: Not every epoch must populate every domain artificially. Reallocate historically empty cells inside the same epoch, but every domain must receive at least 12 trajectories across the full study and at least 3 deep Anchors overall.

geographicBalance.rule: Do not force ahistorical equal shares in early industrialization; enforce balance over the full cohort and increasingly after 1900.

antiBiasControls: Nobel laureates and patents may seed discovery but cannot define the sample frame
each deep Anchor requires at least one serious rival/alternative route or explicit reason none existed
separate invention/discovery, validation, diffusion and institutionalization dates
distinguish person-level credit from distributed precursor/complement networks
record negative externalities and displaced alternatives
record contemporary uncertainty separately from retrospective consensus
do not code LW0 motif labels during source collection
retain residual/unmapped historical structures rather than forcing every case into the frozen vocabulary

analysisPasses.name: source_native_reconstruction
analysisPasses.rule: Lock chronology, actors, pressure, evidence, rivals, performance, diffusion and consequences without LW0 labels.

analysisPasses.name: frozen_motif_mapping
analysisPasses.rule: A separate pass maps locked evidence to frozen LW0 invariants/anti-laws, including explicit NONE/CONTRADICTS values.

analysisPasses.name: residual_discovery
analysisPasses.rule: Collect recurrent structures not explained by LW0; examples such as complements, standards, instrumentation or diffusion lag are exploratory until independently recurrent.

analysisPasses.name: cross_epoch_recurrence
analysisPasses.rule: Use unique trajectory/domain/epoch support rather than raw mention counts; test recurrence, contradictions and changing applicability.

analysisPasses.name: prospective_historical_replay
analysisPasses.rule: On the 32 de-identified holdouts, predict bottleneck/route/falsifier/complements from pre-outcome packets before revealing later outcome evidence.

graduationCriteria: 320 trajectories reached with epoch/domain/control quotas or documented historical-empty exceptions
all 96 deep Anchors satisfy evidence-bundle contract
32 prospective replay cases completed without changing frozen hypotheses after outcome reveal
every stable-invariant/anti-law claim reports support, contradiction, non-applicability and residual cases rather than only positive examples
at least one older non-agent domain family materially falsifies or narrows a current LW0 prior, otherwise review the coding protocol for confirmation bias
new historical motifs require recurrence across at least three epochs and three materially different domains before becoming candidate priors
no historical recurrence automatically promotes a product mechanism or semantic primitive
